headline: Community Health Program Coordinator
summary: Barangay health worker of four years now coordinating a community health program for a foundation in Basilan. I organise outreach in island barangays, talk with families about their health and social needs, and link them to clinics and support services. I keep careful records of every household we visit.

projects.name: Mothers' outreach in island barangays
bullets: Organised monthly boat outreach to four island barangays with a midwife and a nurse.
Prenatal check-up coverage rose from about half to 80% of pregnant women in a year.

projects.name: Household health mapping
projects.description: Mapped 600 households and their health needs, used by the rural health unit to plan vaccination drives.

skills: Talking with families in Yakan, Chavacano and Filipino
Linking families to clinics and community resources

experience.title: Community Health Program Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate outreach teams and volunteer health workers in eight barangays.
Refer families to clinics, nutrition programs and livelihood support, and follow up each referral.
Keep household visit records and write monthly program reports.

experience.title: Barangay Health Worker
bullets: Took blood pressure and weight during home visits and recorded them on family health cards.
Accompanied mothers and children to check-ups and vaccination days.
Gave first aid during community events and emergencies.
